pages.text: The $(item)Entity Wormhole$() is a mystical teleportation device maintained by a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$(),$(br) capable of instantly transporting living beings across vast distances. Once attuned,$(br) it creates a stable rift that creatures can step through, linking $()
distant points as if$(br) they were side by side. The Djinni ensures the wormhole remains open and aligned,$(br) making it a reliable—though undeniably arcane—means of travel.$(br2)
You can also choose the $(item)Otherrock$() version if you want.$(br)

pages.title: Set destination
pages.text: To set the destination, you''ll need a compass. Right-click to place it and shift+right-click to remove it.$(br)+ A standard compass takes you to the world spawn;$(br)+ A compass attached to a lodestone takes you to the top of it. (After placing it in the $()

pages.title: Set destination
pages.text: wormhole, the lodestone can be broken);$(br)

pages.title: Other compasses
pages.text: + A compass renamed "$(#AA00AA)HOME$()" teleport for your personal spawn point;$(br)+ A compass renamed "$(#AA00AA)RTP$()" acts as a Random Teleport;$(br2)Alternatively, you can use special compasses:$(br)+ $(item)recovery compass$() teleports to the location of your $()

pages.title: Other compasses
pages.text: last death, works only for players;$(br)+ $(item)Vitality Compass$() teleports to the linked creature, it needs to be in a loaded chunk;$(br)

pages.title: Exit viewing direction
pages.text: Using a $(item)Spirit Attuned Gem$() will define the yaw viewing angle after teleportation.$(br)An iesnium nugget will point to the set direction like a compass rose.$(br)

pages.title: Exit viewing inclination
pages.text: If you hold the gem in your off-hand, it will change the pitch viewing angle.$(br) A six-pointed star in the center of the portal indicates the current setting:$(br)+ Emerald -> Forward$(br)+ Iron -> Tilted Down$()

pages.title: Exit viewing inclination
pages.text: $(br)+ Redstone -> Straight Down$(br)+ Diamond -> Tilted Up$(br)+ Gold -> Straight Up$(br)

pages.title: Get over here!
pages.text: If the wormhole contains an $(l:crafting_rituals/vitality_compass)Vitality Compass$(/l), you can use a fishing rod to pull the linked$(br) entity into the portal, the hook needs to stop in the portal before you pull.$(br)
